decisions.decision: ADR tech/0012: enum-like constants declared as `const X = { KEY: "KEY" } as const` with a derived `(typeof X)[keyof typeof X]` type — never TS's native `enum`
decisions.rationale: Direct user-specified pattern, now the standing convention for all future enum-like values

decisions.decision: ADR tech/0013: new src/types/ placement-rule destination for domain-agnostic runtime-free type declarations; first trait ClassNameProp, composed via intersection, retrofitted across all 13-14 inline `{ className?: string }` occurrences
decisions.rationale: User wanted the className prop type deduplicated and made composable/reusable

decisions.decision: ADR tech/0014: every primitive's *entire* *.test.tsx suite runs at both viewports via describeForEachDevice (not just hand-picked assertions) — retroactive to all 7 primitives and standing convention for all future components; new src/test-utils/ placement-rule destination
decisions.rationale: User explicitly wants this as blanket coverage/regression net, confirmed the ~2x test-runtime cost is accepted

decisions.decision: ADR tech/0015: every function is `export const foo = () => {}`, never a `function` declaration/expression (except Next.js-forced default-export files, which use a two-line const-then-export-default pattern) — enforced via eslint-plugin-prefer-arrow-functions + func-style
decisions.rationale: Direct user style preference, now standing convention, autofix-enforced
